task.title: Count a repeated word only inside one text node as a doubled word
task.body:
Why: packages/seo/src/domain/content-lint.ts:73-81 tokenises the whole page text, which stripTags joins with spaces across element boundaries, so a heading `Oferta` followed by a paragraph starting `Oferta dla firm`, or two list items starting with the same word, raise a false `content-doubled-word`. Outcome: `lintContent(html, facts)` (src/domain/content-lint.ts) reports `content-doubled-word` only for a word repeated inside one text node (for example `

Zamów zamów ofertę

`, `

Dziś dziś jest promocja

`). The same word ending one block element and starting the next (`

Oferta

Oferta dla firm

`, `
  • Kontakt
  • Kontakt telefoniczny
`) is not reported. All other content rules are unchanged. Proof: the implementer adds tests in tests/domain/content-lint.test.ts for a repetition across a heading and paragraph, across list items, and inside one paragraph.

spec:

install: npm --prefix packages/seo ci --silent && npm --prefix packages/seo run build --silent
test: cd packages/seo && npx vitest run tests/hidden/hidden.test.ts
